shellCommands.command: cat /home/sandbox/workspace/.agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md; echo ----; ls -la /home/sandbox/workspace; echo ----; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/AGENTS.md; echo ----; cat /home/sandbox/workspace/package.json 2>/dev/null; find /home/sandbox/workspace -path '*/node_modules' -prune -o -type f -print | grep -v '^/home/sandbox/workspace/.git/' | head -50

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts; echo ---- ; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; echo ---- ; head -60 .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md; echo ----; grep -n -i -C 3 'theme' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md | head -120

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/; bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme Switch SegmentedRadioGroup 2>&1 | head -60; echo ----; grep -n -C 4 -E 'ThemeProvider|useTheme|useThemeValue|useThemeType' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -150

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit; ls $U/build/esm/components/theme/ 2>/dev/null; echo ----; cat $U/build/esm/components/theme/index.d.ts $U/build/esm/components/theme/ThemeProvider.d.ts $U/build/esm/components/theme/useTheme.d.ts $U/build/esm/components/theme/useThemeValue.d.ts $U/build/esm/components/theme/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null; echo ----; grep -rn -A4 'export declare function useTheme\b\|export declare function useThemeType\|export declare function useThemeValue' $U/build/esm/components/theme/*.d.ts; echo ----; grep -n 'export' $U/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts $U/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/SegmentedRadioGroup.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; ls $U/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/ 2>/dev/null; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head -3; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -i -E '^(Sun|Moon)'

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; cat $U/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts; grep -n -A14 'export interface ControlProps' $U/components/types.d.ts; grep -n 'export declare const Text\b\|export declare const Flex\b\|export declare function Flex\|export declare const Button\b' -r $U/components/Text/Text.d.ts $U/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts $U/components/Button/Button.d.ts; grep -n "variant" $U/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -5; grep -n 'gap\|direction\|alignItems' $U/components/layout/Flex/Flex.d.ts | head -8

cd /home/sandbox/workspace; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; grep -n "CardType =\|CardView =" $U/components/Card/Card.d.ts; grep -o "\-\-g-spacing-6" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css | head -1; grep -n -c "g-root_theme_dark" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/styles/styles.css; npm run build 2>&1 | tail -8; git status --short
cd /home/sandbox/workspace; cat .gitignore; grep -q '^dist' .gitignore || rm -rf dist; git status --short | grep dist || echo "dist not in status"
